facts.fact: SimpleTexting's estimated monthly cost for the recommended plan is $39.00.
facts.quote: Estimated monthly cost$39.00

facts.fact: The recommended plan costs $39.00 per month when billed yearly, which totals $398.40 per year.

facts.fact: A local number costs $10 per month plus a $4 activation fee, with same-day activation.
facts.quote: $10/mo + $4 activation fee | Same-day activation

facts.fact: A toll-free number has no additional fee, but it can take up to a week to gain carrier approval to start texting.
facts.quote: It can take up to a week to gain approval from carriers to start texting on your toll-free number

facts.fact: A dedicated short code begins at $1,000 per month and takes 6-8 weeks to provision.
facts.quote: Dedicated short code Begins at $1,000/mo | Activation time varies

facts.fact: Dedicated short codes take 6-8 weeks to provision.
facts.quote: Dedicated short codes take 6-8 weeks to provision.

facts.fact: Additional teammail seats cost $20 per month per user.
facts.quote: $20/mo  per user

facts.fact: Additional numbers cost $10 per month per number.
facts.quote: $10/mo  per number

facts.fact: All paid SimpleTexting plans include three user seats.
facts.quote: All paid plans come with three user seats.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting states carrier fees average about $0.0025 per message in the United States and $0.0068 in Canada, and it does not mark these up.
facts.unit: USD per message (US); 0.0068 USD per message (Canada)
facts.quote: these carrier fees amount to approximately $0.0025 per message in the United States and $0.0068 in Canada. We never mark these up.

facts.fact: Nonprofits, churches, and other tax-exempt organizations receive 15% off any monthly plan.
facts.quote: Nonprofits, churches, and other tax-exempt organizations receive 15% off any of our monthly plans.

facts.fact: All incoming SMS messages are free, while incoming MMS messages cost 1 credit each.
facts.quote: All incoming SMS messages are free! Incoming messages with photos or other media attached (MMS) cost 1 credit each.

facts.fact: An SMS is limited to 160 characters and costs 1 credit.
facts.quote: SMS is limited to 160 characters and costs 1 credit each.

facts.fact: Extended messaging allows up to 306 characters per message and costs 2 credits per extended message.
facts.quote: With our extended messaging feature, you can send messages up to 306 characters. Each extended message costs 2 credits.

facts.fact: MMS allows up to 1,600 characters and costs 3 credits each.
facts.quote: MMS allows up to 1,600 characters, costs 3 credits each.

facts.fact: On monthly plans, remaining plan credits roll over until the end of the following month.
facts.quote: On monthly plans, remaining plan credits roll over until the end of the following month.

facts.fact: Downgrading a plan causes rollover credits to be lost.
facts.quote: If you downgrade your plan, your rollover credits will be lost.

facts.fact: The seasonal-business option states that paying annually for a bucket of credits upfront saves 20%.
facts.quote: Plus, you save 20%!

facts.fact: The plan questionnaire assumes that for the 'Sometimes' MMS option, 1 in 3 messages will be an MMS.
facts.quote: We'll assume 1 in 3 messages will be an MMS.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting says local numbers can reliably message several thousand people per day.
facts.quote: you can reliably message several thousand people per day.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting reports 10+ years in business, 17,000+ paying customers, and billions of texts delivered.
facts.quote: 10+ years in business. 17,000+ paying customers. Billions of texts delivered.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting offers live support 7 days per week.
facts.quote: Live support 7 days per week

facts.fact: Dedicated short codes are 5 to 6-digit numbers.
facts.quote: These short 5 to 6-digit numbers are great for advertising campaigns and mass texting.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting states that it helps businesses in the US & Canada only.
facts.quote: Just so you know, SimpleTexting helps businesses in US & Canada only.
